newsitem.title: UK: T&N shares drop after in-line results.
newsitem.headline: T&N shares drop after in-line results.

text.p: Shares in T&N Plc dropped in early trading on Wednesday after the auto parts group posted a heavy pre-tax loss for the past year after taking a big charge for asbestos-related diseases.
Underlying pre-tax profits before one-off items of 95 million stg was in line with the consensue of analyst expectations, which ranged from 78 million stg to 105 million.
"The figures are a bit disappointing compared with the more optimistic expectations, there had been quite a few "buy" recommendations ahead of the results," said one senior trader.
The stock was down 7-1/2p at 152 by 0827 GMT.
The company said its operating margins narrowed to 9.1 percent from 11.0 percent in 1995, reflecting higher rationalisation costs, de-stocking and price pressures.

Chairman Sir Colin Hope said restucturing charges and adverse currency would slow progress in the short term yet he was, "confident that the drive to reduce costs and determination to exploit our engineering excellence and talent for innovation will bring future success."
